description: Defines a lightweight `Codable` wrapper `AnyCodable` for handling heterogeneous JSON payloads with support for round-trip encoding and decoding. It provides mechanisms to encode/decode various primitive and collection types, normalize values, and conform to `Hashable`.

classes.name: AnyCodable
classes.description: A `Codable`, `Hashable`, `Sendable` wrapper that can encode/decode heterogeneous types, including primitives, arrays, and dictionaries.

methods.name: init(_ value: Any)
methods.description: Initializer that wraps a value and normalizes it for encoding.

methods.name: init(from decoder: Decoder) throws
methods.description: Decodes a value from the provided `Decoder`, supporting multiple types.

methods.name: encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws
methods.description: Encodes the wrapped value into the provided `Encoder`, supporting multiple types.

methods.name: == (lhs: AnyCodable, rhs: AnyCodable) -> Bool
methods.description: Checks equality between two `AnyCodable` instances based on their underlying values.

methods.name: hash(into hasher: inout Hasher)
methods.description: Hashes the wrapped value for conforming to `Hashable`, handling multiple types.
